 ORDER

The petitioner herein seeks a direction to the respondents 1 to 4 to deposit the land acquisition compensation amount in respect of the petitioner's property situate in S.Nos.280/14A2 and 280/12A2 located in Pacode A Village, Vilavancode Taluk, Kanyakumari District to the credit of O.S.No.46 of 2024 on the file of the Sub Court, Kuzhithurai.
2.Mr.A.Baskaran, learned Additional Government Pleader takes notice for the respondents 1 to 4.
By consent of both parties, the writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

sentences.text: Since no adverse order is passed against the respondents 5 and 6, notice to them is dispensed with.
3.It is the case of the petitioner that subject property was settled by his father under a settlement deed dated 04.04.2023.
The patta for the subject property was also issued in the name of the petitioner in patta No. 7196.

The subject property was acquired by the Government under the provisions of Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 and the compensation amount has also been determined by the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (
Uploaded on: 20/08/2025 11:52:24 am )

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: competent authority.

The private respondents 5 and 6 created fradulent documents and claimed right over the subject property and in respect of the same,
proceeding is pending on the file of the District Revenue Officer, Nagercoil.

The petitioner on his part filed a civil suit in O.S.No. 46 of 2024 on the file of the Sub Court, Kuzhithalai against the private respondents seeking declaration and injunction and the same is pending.
Therefore, the petitioner filed instant writ petition seeking direction to the official respondents to deposit the compensation amount to the credit of O.S.No.46 of 2024.
4.From the averment containing in the affidavit it is clear that there is a dispute with regard to the title over the subject property between the petitioner and the private respondents 5 and 6.

In such circumstances, it is for the official respondents to deposit the compensation amount before the civil Court as per the statutory mandate under Section 10(3) of Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act.

sentences.text: Therefore, the second respondent is directed to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 08.07.2024 and take a decision with regard to the deposit of compensation amount before civil court, within a period of twelve weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, after issuing notice to the private respondents 5 and 6.

https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 20/08/2025 11:52:24 am )
5.With the above direction, this writ petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently the connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
